next_mission: Complete monitoring system integration and advance to the next engineering phase.

steps.name: Project Foundation
steps.summary: Repository, project structure, baseline configuration and development workflow established.
steps.what_it_does: Creates the foundation required to safely develop Einstein AI V2.
next_actions: Maintain the foundation while higher-level systems are developed.

steps.name: V2 Data Architecture
steps.summary: Defined the V2 evidence, source and cognitive-data organization.
steps.what_it_does: Provides structured data organization for future cognitive and reasoning systems.
next_actions: Expand validated data as new research sources are acquired.

steps.name: Cognitive Reconstruction
steps.summary: Defined the cognitive reconstruction architecture without claiming biological brain reconstruction.
steps.what_it_does: Models reasoning-related capabilities as software modules rather than attempting to reproduce a biological brain.
next_actions: Connect cognitive modules to future reasoning pipelines.

steps.name: Evidence Acquisition
steps.summary: Established the controlled acquisition pipeline for research and evidence sources.
steps.what_it_does: Finds, validates and stores source material that can later support model development.
remaining: Continue acquisition when additional authoritative sources are required.
next_actions: Expand the evidence corpus when required by later reasoning modules.

steps.name: Research Extraction
steps.summary: Research documents were processed through controlled extraction and validation workflows.
steps.what_it_does: Converts source documents into usable research evidence while preserving validation information.
remaining: Perform additional extraction as the corpus grows.
next_actions: Feed validated evidence into future dataset construction.

steps.name: Reasoning Dataset Construction
steps.summary: Transform validated research evidence into structured examples for reasoning and evaluation.
steps.what_it_does: Creates training and evaluation material focused on reasoning patterns rather than simply storing documents.
remaining: Add positive and negative reasoning examples
next_actions: Freeze the first usable dataset version

steps.name: Reasoning Engine
steps.summary: Build the software reasoning pipeline that can decompose problems, generate hypotheses and evaluate alternatives.
steps.what_it_does: Forms the core problem-solving layer of Einstein AI V2.

steps.name: Memory Architecture
steps.summary: Implement persistent knowledge, working memory and episodic/project memory.
steps.what_it_does: Allows the system to retain useful project knowledge and reasoning history.

steps.name: Mixture-of-Experts Architecture
steps.summary: Separate major capabilities into specialized reasoning experts coordinated by an orchestration layer.
steps.what_it_does: Allows different expert modules to specialize in physics, mathematics, research analysis, creativity and other reasoning domains.

steps.name: Monitoring + Owner Control Center
steps.summary: Build a project command center that tells the owner what has been completed, what remains and what should happen next.
steps.what_it_does: Provides project-level visibility and control without exposing unnecessary developer controls.
next_actions: Continue project engineering from NEXT MISSION
